raw_segments.text: It opened to the ground and looked into a most miserable corner of the neglected garden,
upon a rank ruin of cabbage stalks and one box-tree that had been clipped round long
ago, like a pudding, and had a new growth at the top of it, out of shape and of a different
color, as if that part of the pudding had stuck to the saucepan and got burnt.
This was my homely thought as I contemplated the box-tree.
There had been some light snow overnight and it lay nowhere else to my knowledge, but it
had not quite melted from the cold shadow of this bit of garden, and the wind caught
it up in little eddies and threw it at the window, as if it pelted me for coming there.
